title: fix(plugin-view): a page record surface with no onNavigate opens create, edit and view on a fallback surface (objectui#11015)
body:
Fixes #11015
Clause-②: no
Why no: an offered control that does nothing gets a surface; no published type, schema or accept set moves.

With a `page` record surface and no `onNavigate`, `ObjectView`'s New button, a row click and Edit now open the record form on the drawer. Implemented by the `domain:ui` seat 2 dispatch (PM claim `5882099479`), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`.

## Measured first, in a real browser (the triage direction's first step)

A throwaway Vite entry in `apps/console` (never committed, deleted after) mounted the REGISTERED `object-view` renderer through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `SchemaRendererProvider`, with a fake data source and the schema `{ type: 'object-view', objectName: 'task' }`. Playwright drove Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`), counting drawers (`[data-vaul-drawer]`) and dialogs (`[role="dialog"]`) after each click.

| scenario | derived surface | New, before | row click, before | New, after | row click, after | Edit, after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 390px viewport, 3-field object | `page` | 0 drawers, 0 dialogs | 0, 0 | drawer, "Create Tasks" | drawer, "View Tasks" | no Edit affordance on the mobile cards |
| 1280px viewport, 13-field object | `page` | 0, 0 | 0, 0 | drawer, "Create Tasks" | drawer, "View Tasks" | drawer, "Edit Tasks" |
| CONTROL: 1280px, 3-field object | `drawer` | drawer | drawer | drawer | drawer | drawer |

The card's premise held: the derived-page path opened nothing. Edit was not driven in the browser before the fix; the DOM pins below cover it, and the ablation shows it red. On the 390px viewport the drawer renders as a bottom sheet (screenshot read).

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`: one derived value, `recordSurface`, computed once beside `layout`: a `page` with no `onNavigate` resolves to `'drawer'`, anything else is `layout`. `handleCreate`, `handleEdit`, `handleView`, `formLayout` and `renderCreateSurface` read it and no longer read `layout`, so no two readers disagree. The drawer is the surface PR objectui#11014 already gave create for a page under `split` / `popover`: `renderCreateSurface` now reads the same value, so it is one rule, not a second one. A `page` with an `onNavigate` still routes all three verbs, and its render path is unchanged (`formLayout` is still `'page'` there and draws no form).
- A derived `page` is not refused. An explicit `layout: 'page'` without `onNavigate` (the README's documented misconfiguration) shares the fallback, as the triage direction allows.
- `packages/plugin-view/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx`, the same edits in each (the docs page mirrors the README, the objectui#10975 precedent, and AGENTS.md rule #2 asks for both):
  - Create: the card's drift. The new-record form opens on the surface a `drawer` or `modal` navigation names, and on the `layout` surface otherwise. A `page` surface, authored or derived, hands New to `onNavigate` whatever the navigation, and falls back to the drawer without one.
  - Configuring the record form, Opening a record, and Update: one sentence each on the fallback. Opening a record also says that a row click under `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` with no `onNavigate` opens nothing, which is unchanged.
  - Every fenced code block in both files is byte-identical at base and head (sha1 of the concatenated fenced lines is equal), so only prose moved.
- New pin file `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.pageSurfaceFallback-11015.test.tsx`: 14 cases. The fix rows mount the registered renderer through the real `SchemaRenderer` with no `onNavigate`: a field-heavy object (`RECORD_SURFACE_PAGE_THRESHOLD` fields, desktop) and a mobile viewport (390px, light object), each of create, view and edit opening its form inside the drawer; the heavy rows also assert the loaded object label in the title, so the surface was chosen after the field count was known. One row covers an explicit `layout: 'page'`. Controls: the same object and viewport with an `onNavigate` still route each verb (`('new', 'edit')`, `('r1', 'view')`, `('r1', 'edit')`) and open no form, which is also the proof that the derived surface is `page` there; and a light object on a desktop still opens the drawer.
- New changeset `.changeset/11015-page-surface-fallback.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-view': patch`.

## Tests and gates (final head `3f0495c`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/` plus the 19 tests `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` records as readers of the two edited docs and `.changeset/**` (among them `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`): `Test Files 77 passed (77)`, `Tests 1643 passed (1643)`. The 77 is 58 plugin-view test files (`git ls-files` count, including PR objectui#11014's `ObjectView.splitPopoverCreate-10975.test.tsx`) plus the 19 readers.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-view^...'`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin, so the test program covered it.
- eslint: `eslint .` in `packages/plugin-view` (73 files by the JSON count): 0 errors. `ObjectView.tsx` carries the same 60 warnings by rule at base and head; the new pin carries none.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `check-handler-key-read-sites`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major`, the three `check-vi-mock-*`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-example-shared-reader`: all exit 0. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the five paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED: `check-readme-exports`, `check-doc-snippet-types`, `check-doc-example-types`, reason: each needs every documented package's `dist`, and only the plugin-view closure was built here. They judge fenced code and import bindings, and the fenced blocks of both edited docs are byte-identical at base and head.

## Reverse verification

With the fix committed (`b585221`), `ablation-replace` swapped the one line `const recordSurface = layout === 'page' && !schema.onNavigate ? 'drawer' : layout;` for `const recordSurface = layout;` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed) and ran the pin file: `Tests 7 failed | 7 passed (14)`. The seven red rows are exactly the fix rows (create, view and edit on the heavy object and on mobile, plus the explicit `layout: 'page'`); the seven controls stayed green. The restore leg reported blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- The triage direction describes PR objectui#11014's surface as "the drawer, or the modal on mobile". On `main`, that surface is the modal for `layout: 'modal'` and the drawer otherwise, and `viewport` never enters it; on mobile with no authored `layout` the derived surface is `page`, so objectui#11014's rule already gave the drawer. This PR reuses that rule as it is, so on mobile the fallback is the drawer (a bottom sheet at 390px). Raised in the report for the PM.
- Not changed here, and documented rather than changed: with `navigation: { mode: 'page' }` and no `onNavigate`, a row click still opens nothing. That mode is always authored, the README already calls it a misconfiguration, and the triage direction scoped the fallback to the record surface.
- On a 390px viewport the grid's card layout offers no Edit control, so Edit on mobile is reached only through the handler `ObjectGrid` receives; the pin drives it there.
